name: Party Crasher
text: Once per game: your next minion can be placed on a space a rival already took.

name: Big Spender
text: Once per game: recruit twice this turn.

name: Alchemist
text: You may pay any member’s colored part in any colors.

name: Insider
text: You may also recruit from the top 3 of the pile.

name: Extra Hand
text: Once per game: +1 minion this round.

name: Launderers
text: Worth 2 followers. On Recruit: turn all your resources into one color you choose.

name: Saboteur
text: Whenever this joins your cult, −3 followers.

name: Dabblers
text: Counts as 2 members of every color.

name: Cheerleader
text: Whenever you win a contest, +1 follower.

name: Anarchist
text: Once per round: swap any two members within 2 cost.

name: Scout
text: Once per round: send any shop members to the bottom of the pile, then refill.

name: Con Men
text: Counts as 2 members. On Recruit: steal 5 resources.

name: HR
text: Worth 3 followers. Game End: +3 followers per color you have 3 members of.

name: Coach
text: On Recruit: use one of your used Once per game members again.

name: Tiebreaker
text: Ties you’re in go to you alone.
